|rulings=* To initiate the first function requires a card in Force Pile.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json complete Dark-side card data] (revision d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), Endless Legions, card 7447.</ref>
* To initiate the first function also requires a card in hand, but [[Endless Legions]] itself satisfies this requirement (provided that it is being played from hand).
* If the Force Pile contains only 1 or 2 cards, the player will draw them, then the action will end without placing any cards back.
